description: Name a price for a seller's product and get the answer: accept, counter or reject, with the price and the reason. The first offer opens a negotiation and returns a buyer token, once: keep it. To make the next offer in the same negotiation, pass negotiation_id and buyer_token too. buyer_ref is an optional opaque reference for the seller and never a name or email. quantity, annual_commitment and term_months describe the deal for the seller's volume and commitment terms; the answer may carry the seller's terms and a message. The seller's floor is never breached or shown. Public: needs no credential, and it is limited per address and by the rounds the seller allows.

annual_commitment.description: True to commit for a year or more, for the seller's annual commitment terms. Read when the negotiation opens.

buyer_ref.description: An opaque reference for the seller's bookkeeping. Never a name or email.

buyer_token.description: The buyer token the first answer gave you, once. Keep it: it is the only way back into the negotiation.

handle.description: The seller's public handle, from the terms they publish.

negotiation_id.description: The negotiation id from the first answer.

offered_price.description: The price you offer, in the seller's currency.

product_id.description: The seller's id for the product.

quantity.description: How many you would buy, for the seller's volume terms. Read when the negotiation opens.

term_months.description: How many months you commit to, for the seller's commitment terms. Read when the negotiation opens.

name: make_offer
